title: Local pivot hierarchy for rigid articulated parts
summary: Separate placement from local joint frames so a rigid assembly can be positioned and posed without baking mesh transforms.
terms: joint hinge pivot rigid articulated assembly
関節 支点 回転軸 剛体 組立

principle.invariant: Parent rigid parts to the joint that moves them; downstream joints inherit upstream motion.
principle.interface: One assembly placement frame plus named local-axis joint rotations.
principle.variation: Pose native joint frames; keep handmade shell and rigid source geometry.

evidence.claim: Independent lamp append and head rotation move bulb geometry without moving another lamp.

limits: Only this lamp has been tested; transfer to other assemblies is inferred.
Static cable does not follow all joint poses; use a separate deformation/refit method.
This is not evidence for character skinning topology or deformation.

promotion.next: Try another independently authored rigid assembly before introducing a generic rig builder.

provenance.source: Project-authored lamp example and native hierarchy; no third-party model copied.
